text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—A Triple Crown Umamusume is born right 
here! Narita Brian has finally done it!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian!! Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A massive chorus of 'Brian' echoes from 
the stands! Kyoto Racecourse is engulfed 
in thunderous cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten even stronger since the 
Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
A true "monster" indeed... Ah, excuse me! 
Could you look this way, please?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press's cameras all turned toward 
Narita Brian at once. She was, without a 
shadow of a doubt, a Triple Crown 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It began with the Satsuki Sho, and 
now it's concluded with this Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This past year... no, even before my 
debut. You were always—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, whoa whoa whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you trying to wrap this up 
already?! You guys are dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, Ama-san, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's me! And Brian, step outside. We 
need to talk.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why don't we have a talk?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I made my mark in the Tiara route. You 
shone bright with the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've come all this way—we can't just end 
it with a "we both did our best," can we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Even winning the Triple Crown 
does not satisfy this heart of mine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you could say I've grown 
even thirstier. Have you actually become 
an opponent worthy of quenching that?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on. I'll crush you without 
breaking a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer. As for the next race...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Time to go fulfill our promise...!
